question: Which country hosted the G20 summit in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 2019 G20 summit was held at the International Exhibition Center in** Osaka, Japan**.
 
• The event took place on **June 28-29, 2019**. It was the **first time Japan** hosted a G20 summit.
 
• The G20 consists of 19 countries and the European Union&
